  "pros": [
    "Efficiently manages customer communications from multiple channels in one inbox.",
    "Provides a cost-effective solution for a small design company.",
    "Streamlines email processing and ticket management."

  "cons": [
    "Occasional software bugs and performance slowdowns can be frustrating.",
    "System outages and malfunctions sometimes affect accessibility.",
    "The mobile version may lack some essential tools."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This manager, from a small design firm, has used LiveAgent for over two years to consolidate customer communications. They appreciate its ability to manage multiple channels efficiently and its cost-effectiveness, especially coming from Help Scout. While the core functionality meets their needs, they have encountered some frustrations with software bugs, performance issues, and occasional system instability."
